Maria: Quick brain dump — idea for next webinar: 'Ignite: Serving for interactive products' — focus on low-latency UX, model fallbacks, and cost controls. Short 45m + AMA. Thoughts?
Jack: Love it. Can we anchor to a customer case? Preferably a memory-heavy chat app.
Sophie: We have a willing customer (AcmeFlow). They can present a 7-min case on routing + KV caching.
Kevin: Speaker recs: Olivia (platform), Raj (prod eng) + AcmeFlow PM. Need to confirm.
Maria: Olivia, Raj — are you available Weds Apr 12 10am PT for a dry run?
Olivia: Yes for rehearsal. Need a 30m slot. Also will do a 2-min recorded failover demo.
Sophie: Outline idea for run-of-show:
- 0:00–5:00 intro & TL;DR
- 5:00–15:00 AcmeFlow case (customer)
- 15:00–30:00 technical deep dive (routing, batching, caching)
- 30:00–40:00 live demo + failover
- 40:00–45:00 AMA
Kevin: Demo plan: primary = hosted API stream; fallback = prerecorded + local quantized model. Put both in speaker notes.
Maria: Marketing asks: hero graphic, 1-sentence blurb, 3 CTAs (register, benchmark whitepaper, request demo).
Sophie: Benchmark narrative bullets for slides:
1) latency vs tokens (median p50/p95)
2) unit cost by quantization (int8 vs fp16)
3) throughput gains from batching
Add an appendix with eval prompts + perf numbers.
Jack: Lead routing — when people register mark as source=webinar; route to SDR queue 'inbound-llm-ignite'. OpsBot will create the Zap. @OpsBot can you confirm?
OpsBot: Zap created: registrations -> crm/salesforce -> queue: inbound-llm-ignite. Test webhook sent.
Maria: Rehearsal checklist (to pin):
- slides deck + speaker notes
- pre-recorded fallback video
- test stream + captions
- registration form + UTM
- SDR routing test
Kevin: Can someone pull the demo runbook and paste a minimal command we can run locally?
Olivia: paste:
```
# run local fallback
python serve_local_model.py --model quantized-v2 --port 8080 --max-seq 1024
```
Maria: OK I'll lock speakers today and create calendar invites for rehearsal. Small follow-up: aim to have deck draft end of week.
Sophie: Great — I'll start the hero copy + CTAs and loop design. :sparkles:
